excluded_attempts.reason: Acquisition interrupted by client standby and subsequent connection failures; no successful subset promoted.

E03.scope: Three independent client sessions with fresh aggregation and discovery processes on the same physical setup. The interrupted earlier acquisition is excluded as a whole, not a successful subset.

E08.scope: Read observations recalculated; integration and process-test outcomes are recorded observations. Local synthetic sources only. Process termination requires external restart and is not continuous availability.

methods.standard_deviation: Sample standard deviation across three separate runs, n-1 denominator.
methods.CPU: Combined aggregator and discovery-service CPU-time deltas per actual sampling interval. Acquisition-to-terminal mean weights only complete mapped intervals within that window.
methods.memory: Peak combined aggregator/discovery-service RSS over each complete unsmoothed recording, in MiB. Source-host memory is excluded.
methods.network: Full-recording integral of the published interval rate. Legacy net_in_mbps is in MiB/s. Packet-exact acquisition-to-terminal network values are reported audited outputs and cannot be rederived without the excluded captures.
methods.timing: Phase totals are recalculated across the published per-run timing table. Reconstructing individual phases from private original logs is outside this subset; rule commit is included in other processing, not an additional summand.
methods.display: Paper resource graphs show a mean of three runs, a 750 s view and a centered 31 s display mean. This CLI uses complete unsmoothed recordings of at least 2000 s; display cropping/smoothing do not enter the numerical summaries.

limitations: Compact semantic and lifecycle reports are reported outputs from retained audits, not a rerun of full semantic validation.
Full address spaces, generated rules, source-runtime archives and robot model payloads are excluded.
No packet captures, private endpoints, credentials, deployment PKI or host-specific runtime copies are distributed.
E09 numeric calculations use complete unsmoothed recordings. The paper display is 750 s with a 31 s centered display mean and a mean of three runs per source count.
E10 integration completion is distinct from full trial acceptance. B100 is two accepted trials out of three; all three integrated 100 sources. F24 is three accepted trials.
No full paper recreation, independent hardware repeatability, industrial reliability or continuous availability is established by this subset.
